texts: When a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern produces mist-light.
Whenever a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern gives mist-light.
Mist-light is a pale silver flame.
Ordinary oil does not produce mist-light.

fields.sentence: When a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern produces mist-light.
parse: (: lantern_burn_produce (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (Member $e1 burn) (Agent $e1 $x) (Patient $e1 mire_essence)) (And (Member (sk_produce $e1) produce) (Agent (sk_produce $e1) $x) (Patient (sk_produce $e1) mist_light) (During (sk_produce $e1) $e1))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Bare "when P, Q" with an indefinite participant correctly takes the whenever rule machinery (Skolem consequent event + During, no QuantifierPhrase companion), and both hyphenated compounds emit head genus only, since mire/mist are noun modifiers. Roles fit the change test (burn/produce consume-or-create their objects, so Patient both times), and the bare-mass kind fillers are the licensed non-specific form.

fields.sentence: Whenever a lantern burns mire-essence, the lantern gives mist-light.
parse: (: lantern_burn_gives_light (Implication (And (Member $x lantern) (Member $e burn) (Agent $e $x) (Patient $e mire_essence)) (And (Member (sk_give $e) give) (Agent (sk_give $e) $x) (Theme (sk_give $e) mist_light) (During (sk_give $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-routing, the per-occurrence Skolem consequent tied by During, the compound genera (mire_essence to essence, mist_light to light) with noun modifiers suppressed, bare-kind objects, Agent on the transitive inanimate subject and the no-companion rule for whenever all match the instruction set.

fields.sentence: Mist-light is a pale silver flame.

q1_issues.issue: Strength 1.0 with empirical confidence 0.9 is not a licensed combination for a bare generic with no quantifier word - the dial gives (0.9 0.9) for an empirical bare generic or (1.0 0.99) for a definitional one.
Same mismatched truth value (1.0 0.9) on the 'silver' property, and it disagrees with the 0.99 confidence the parse assigns the co-predicated 'flame' atom from the very same predicate NP.

q2_gaps: A shade/degree adjective modifying another adjective inside a predicate NP ('pale silver'): the instruction set covers adjective+noun fusing, coordinated premodifiers sharing a head, and incidental-description splitting, but never a modifier of a modifier, so the parse asserts 'pale' and 'silver' as two independent properties instead of the single shade the phrase names.
review.notes: Compound handling is right: mist_light keeps its noun modifier unexposed and emits only the head genus (Inheritance mist_light light), and the descriptive/colour modifiers are correctly split rather than fused into a compound kind.

issues.reason: For an unquantified Inheritance generic the licensed dial points are (0.9 0.9) empirical or (1.0 0.99) definitional - strength 1.0 at confidence 0.9 is reserved for an explicit universal ('all swans are white') - so (1.0 0.9) on ml_pale is an unlicensed combination.

ml_silver carries the same unlicensed (1.0 0.9) point; the clash with the flame atom's 0.99 is only symptomatic (a definitional genus beside an empirical property is not barred per se), but the mismatched truth value itself stands.

gaps_confirmed: No rule covers an adjective modifying another adjective ('pale silver' as a single shade) inside a predicate NP - only adjective+noun fusing, coordinated premodifiers sharing a head, and incidental-description splitting are legislated.
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form puts ml_pale and ml_silver on a licensed dial point - (STV 0.9 0.9) if the colour claims are read as empirical bare generics, or (STV 1.0 0.99) if read as definitional kind-description like the co-predicated flame atom.
adjudication.notes: Splitting 'pale silver' into two independent properties is acceptable improvisation inside the confirmed gap (both atoms are arguably true of a pale-silver flame), so the defect rests solely on the truth values.

fields.sentence: Ordinary oil does not produce mist-light.

q2_gaps: negated verbal generic whose subject is a bare MASS noun ('ordinary oil'): the stated surface signal for a generic denial is only 'a bare plural or an explicit quantifier', so the rule route for a bare mass subject is not literally licensed (mass is treated as kind-denoting only in the relational-generic trigger)
review.notes: The adjectivally-restricted kind subject correctly forces the distributing-rule route with 'ordinary' as a premise conjunct (not a fused compound), and strength 0.0 / confidence 0.9, Patient for the created object, and the mist_light genus all match the instruction set.
